source_format: share-codex rows containing id, ordered messages, and metadata
publication_basis: Intentional public release of the dataset owner's local Codex and Claude sessions

exporter_controls: developer messages and turn context excluded
37 private working-directory prefixes reviewed and excluded
privacy_review.residual_risk: Secret-scan findings and 3622 rows with no detected repository license require content-minimized research; exporter redaction is not a guarantee that transcript text is risk-free.

embedded_license_review.source_material_risk: Tool output and edited code may carry separate repository rights. Export manifest reports 3622 not_found and 56 unknown session licenses.
embedded_license_review.admitted_use: Structural and lifecycle analysis only; no redistribution, semantic quotation, training, or fine-tuning from transcript content.

sample_design.name: eight_position_strata_with_sixteen_consecutive_rows_each
sample_design.rationale: Cover the full ordered row range while limiting raw temporary material to 128 of 4333 sessions. Consecutive blocks amortize dataset-server access; inference must not treat the sample as random.
sample_design.revision_verification: Every response must include x-revision equal to dataset_revision.

enterprise_transfer: Requires consented multi-user data, independent outcomes, and prospective interventions.
